logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of each Cu(II) complex was determined by the shake flask method and its evaluation was based on partitioning in an octanol-water mixture. A calibration curve (using absorbance at λmax) of each Cu(II) complex was used to determine the concentration of its corresponding Cu(II) complex in the aqueous layer before partitioning (C0) and in the aqueous layer after partitioning (Caq). Then, the logP value of each Cu(II) complex was calculated from Equation 1. Lipophilicity = logP = log((C0 - Caq)/Caq)
